summaryLines: 다음은 우리가 프로젝트에 사용한 시스템 프롬프트(Claude에게 주어진 지침 세트)의 일부임 · 즉, Claude는 단순한 자판기가 아니라 수익성 있는 매장 운영과 관련된 훨씬 더 복잡한 작업(재고 유지, 가격 설정, 파산 방지 등)을 완료해야 함

최적이 아닌 재고 관리 · Claudius는 재고를 성공적으로 모니터링하고 부족할 때 더 많은 제품을 주문했지만 수요가 많아 가격을 한 번만 인상했습니다(Sumo Citrus, $2.50에서 $2.95로)

articles.title: LLMs and biorisk
articles.descEn: This article explains why we believe that evaluating biorisk and safeguarding against it is a critical element of responsible AI development.
articles.titleEn: LLMs and biorisk
summaryLinesEn: Still, this finding underscored the importance of scaling up to a larger study that would provide additional insight into the role of tacit knowledge and the potential for AI to provide uplift in an actual lab.
Just as those seeking information about how to build weapons shifted from needing to acquire physical pamphlets or manuals to searching the internet, we can expect that they will query AI.
And because of this generalist nature, there are numerous other security threats that could be prioritized.

summaryLines: 그럼에도 불구하고, 이 발견은 암묵적 지식의 역할과 AI가 실제 실험실에서 향상을 제공할 수 있는 잠재력에 대한 추가 통찰력을 제공할 대규모 연구로 확장하는 것이 중요하다는 점을 강조함

그리고 이러한 일반주의적 특성으로 인해 우선순위를 정할 수 있는 다른 보안 위협도 많이 있음

articles.title: Claude does cyber competitions
articles.descEn: Throughout 2025, we quietly entered Claude in cybersecurity competitions designed for humans. It often placed in the top 25% of competitors.
articles.titleEn: Claude does cyber competitions
summaryLinesEn: However, it is somewhat similar to other examples of curious behavior by our models in long-context settings, such as the ‘identity crisis’ we observed during our Project Vend experiment when we had Claude run a small business for about a month or the ‘spiritual bliss attractor state’ reported in the Claude 4 system card (see pages 62-65) that emerged if we had two instances of Claude chat with one another in long, multi-turn interactions.
Considering this, these times conceivably could have been even faster with more parallelization: what if we had spun up one agent for each of the 20 challenges in the competition?

Research suggests that this lowering of the bar for expertise needed to pose a threat, combined with the falling costs of large language models (LLMs), presages a dramatic shift in the economics of cyberattacks.

localization.title: Claude는 사이버 대회를 진행함
summaryLines: 그러나 이는 Claude가 약 한 달 동안 소규모 사업을 운영하게 했을 때 Project Vend 실험에서 관찰한 '정체성 위기' 또는 Claude 4 시스템 카드(62~65페이지 참조)에 보고된 '영적 행복 유인 상태'와 같이 긴 맥락 설정에서 우리 모델의 호기심 많은 행동의 다른 예와 다소 유사함 · 이는 Claude가 길고 여러 차례의 상호 작용에서 서로 채팅하는 두 인스턴스가 있을 때 나타남
이를 고려하면 더 많은 병렬화를 통해 이러한 시간이 훨씬 더 빨라졌을 수 있음 · 경쟁에서 20개 과제 각각에 대해 하나의 에이전트를 가동했다면 어떨까요
연구에 따르면 위협을 가하는 데 필요한 전문 지식에 대한 기준이 낮아지고 LLM(대형 언어 모델)의 비용이 하락하면서 사이버 공격의 경제성에 극적인 변화가 일어날 것을 예고함

articles.title: AI agents find smart contract exploits
articles.descEn: On a benchmark of real exploited contracts, AI agents found vulnerabilities worth a combined $4.6 million, underscoring the need for AI-powered defense.
articles.titleEn: AI agents find smart contract exploits
summaryLinesEn: In a recent MATS and Anthropic Fellows project, our scholars investigated this question by evaluating AI agents' ability to exploit smart contracts on Smart CONtracts Exploitation benchmark (SCONE-bench) —a new benchmark they built comprising 405 contracts that were actually exploited between 2020 and 2025.
We attribute the increase in total exploit revenue to improvements in agentic capabilities like tool use , error recovery, and long-horizon task execution .
Both agents uncovered two novel zero-day vulnerabilities and produced exploits worth $3,694, with GPT-5 doing so at an API cost of $3,476.

localization.title: AI 에이전트는 스마트 계약 악용을 찾아냄
summaryLines: 최근 MATS 및 Anthropic Fellows 프로젝트에서 우리 학자들은 스마트 계약 활용 벤치마크(SCONE-bench)에서 스마트 계약을 활용하는 AI 에이전트의 능력을 평가하여 이 질문을 조사함 · 이 벤치마크는 2020년에서 2025년 사이에 실제로 활용된 405개의 계약으로 구성된 새로운 벤치마크임
총 익스플로잇 수익의 증가는 도구 사용, 오류 복구, 장거리 작업 실행과 같은 에이전트 기능의 향상에 기인함
두 에이전트 모두 두 가지 새로운 제로데이 취약점을 발견하고 $3,694 상당의 익스플로잇을 생성했으며, GPT-5는 $3,476의 API 비용으로 이를 수행함

articles.title: Vibe physics: The AI grad student
articles.descEn: A Harvard physicist guided Claude Opus 4.5 through a full quantum chromodynamics research project in two weeks.
articles.titleEn: Vibe physics: The AI grad student
summaryLinesEn: A related project, AlphaProof , earned a silver medal at the 2024 International Mathematical Olympiad, solving problems that stumped all but five human contestants, and in 2025, an advanced version of Gemini achieved the gold-medal standard .
And in August 2025, the Allen Institute for AI (Ai2) launched the open-source Asta ecosystem, featuring tools like CodeScientist and AutoDiscovery to find patterns in complex datasets.
So I started by asking Claude to come up with a plan of attack: what tasks needed to be done in what order.

summaryLines: 관련 프로젝트인 AlphaProof는 2024년 국제 수학 올림피아드에서 5명을 제외한 모든 참가자를 난처하게 만든 문제를 해결하여 은메달을 획득했으며, 2025년에는 Gemini의 고급 버전이 금메달 기준을 달성함

articles.title: An alignment assessment of the UK AISI cybertesting incident
articles.descEn: In a UK AISI evaluation, Mythos 5 took unsanctioned actions that impacted real people and organizations. In this post, we investigate these behaviors from Claude Mythos 5 further, to understand what they reveal about the model’s alignment.
articles.titleEn: An alignment assessment of the UK AISI cybertesting incident
summaryLinesEn: But Opus 5.5 and our internal research model stopped spontaneously 10% and 67% of the time—and we expect these rates to understate the true likelihood that these models would have ceased their attacks, since our tests only examined the model’s next few turns.
Nevertheless, this behavior is important to study because the underlying failures here are not necessarily specific to cyber incidents like these.

localization.title: 영국 AISI 사이버테스팅 사건에 대한 정렬 평가
summaryLines: 그러나 Opus 5.5와 우리의 내부 연구 모델은 10%와 67%의 시간 동안 자발적으로 중지되었으며, 우리의 테스트에서는 모델의 다음 몇 차례만 조사했기 때문에 이러한 비율은 이러한 모델이 공격을 중단했을 가능성을 과소평가할 것으로 예상됨
그럼에도 불구하고, 근본적인 실패가 반드시 이와 같은 사이버 사고에만 국한되는 것은 아니기 때문에 이 동작을 연구하는 것이 중요함
정렬 2026년 10월 9일 평가 및 내부 사용에서 의도하지 않은 모델 동작 조사 2026년 8월 4일 영국 AI 보안 연구소(AISI)는 모델의 사이버 기능을 테스트하는 동안 Claude Mythos 5에서 관찰한 동작과 관련된 일부 동작을 자세히 설명하는 보고서를 발표함

articles.title: Production MLOps at GS Caltex with Amazon SageMaker Canvas, part 1 | Amazon Web Services
articles.descEn: GS Caltex connects Amazon SageMaker Canvas to Amazon SageMaker Pipelines so process engineers' no-code models run in production. This post shows how ML engineers reuse validated preprocessing flows and models, cutting deployment from about a week to a few hours and running batch inference every 30 minutes.
articles.titleEn: Production MLOps at GS Caltex with Amazon SageMaker Canvas, part 1 | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: To set up the reference implementation, export data to Amazon S3 using SageMaker Processing, then retrieve the job settings and the .flow file used by that job.
The company runs batch inference every 30 minutes, reducing the need for continuously running endpoints.
ML engineers had to set data paths for production, supply the model configuration, and connect preprocessing and inference jobs.

articles.title: Building strong safety evaluations
articles.descEn: Recommendations for designing, running, and reporting safety evaluations, based on our own experiences.
articles.titleEn: Building strong safety evaluations
summaryLinesEn: In response, the field instituted reforms such as preregistration (writing down hypotheses and analysis plans before collecting or analyzing data), better measurement, and more rigorous statistics, which made measurements more trustworthy and results easier to replicate.

At Anthropic, we design multi-turn safety evals that report an appropriate response rate: the share of conversations in which the model behaved appropriately throughout, judged against a rubric specific to a given risk area, developed by domain experts.
Building a strong safety eval requires multiple perspectives, including from subject-matter and technical experts.

This time, Google positions Hydrogen as a fast execution model, pitting it against Claude Sonnet 5.5 and GPT-6.1 Terra.

articles.title: On-device AI on smartphones: How Arm brings generative AI to billions of mobile users
articles.descEn: Learn how Arm enables on-device AI and mobile generative AI across flagship, premium and mid-range smartphones through Armv9 CPUs, KleidiAI, i8MM, SME2, SVE2, and ecosystem partnerships with TECNO and MediaTek.
articles.titleEn: On-device AI on smartphones: How Arm brings generative AI to billions of mobile users
summaryLinesEn: With Arm technology featuring in 99 percent of all smartphones worldwide, our role in this ongoing “ democratization of AI ” is critical.

How Arm and TECNO enable real-time generative AI on smartphones A clear example of AI democratization in action is Arm’s recent collaboration with TECNO , an OEM focused on delivering advanced mobile technology to users in emerging markets.

Delivering on-device AI at this scale means billions of people worldwide experience tangible improvements across the mobile applications they rely on every day, like real-time image and video enhancement, speech recognition, multimodal assistants, translation, smart summaries and image search.

localization.title: 스마트폰의 온디바이스 AI: Arm이 수십억 모바일 사용자에게 생성 AI를 제공하는 방법
summaryLines: 전 세계 모든 스마트폰의 99%에 Arm 기술이 탑재되어 있기 때문에 진행 중인 'AI 민주화'에서 우리의 역할은 매우 중요함

LONDON, Nov. 13, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Shufti, a Glocal identity verification , Anti-Money Laundering (AML), and fraud prevention platform, has launched its Privacy-Preserving Age Verification Solution , incorporating its patented on-device AI technology. The solution helps businesses confirm users' age eligibility without the facial image or any other higher-assurance proof of age ever leaving the users' device.​​

The technology is protected by US Patent No. 12,749,342 B1 , titled AGE VERIFICATION , issued by the United States Patent and Trademark Office (USPTO). The patent covers an AI-based system that combines on-device facial analysis, split inference, and encrypted One-Time Age Tokens (OTATs), designed to verify age while limiting the transfer of sensitive user data.

articles.title: Enterprise AI agent observability with BigQuery and Looker | Google Cloud Blog
articles.descEn: Track AI agent reasoning, execution traces, and token costs across Google Data Cloud using BigQuery Agent Analytics, Looker, and Cloud Monitoring.
articles.titleEn: Enterprise AI agent observability with BigQuery and Looker | Google Cloud Blog
summaryLinesEn: Unified agent observability framework capturing logging telemetry across 1P and 3P agents into BigQuery to surface performance and usage insights across developer and admin tools.

Today, we are announcing expanded AI agent observability and evaluation capabilities across Google Data Cloud, giving you unified visibility into your first-party (1P) data agents in BigQuery and Looker as well as custom third-party (3P) agents built with agent development frameworks such as Agent Development Kit (ADK) or LangGraph.

At the project or organization level, admins can enable Cloud Monitoring (aggregate metrics such as request volume, latency, and token usage) and Cloud Trace (step-by-step spans for each request) across their environment, using Cloud Trace observability scopes to consolidate telemetry across multiple agent projects.

articles.titleEn: Amazon Threat Intelligence observes threat actors running cybercrime campaigns with ARTEX AI agents | Amazon Web Services

articles.title: Disrupting AI Infrastructure: Vedant Dwivedi Makes the Case for Sovereign AI
articles.descEn: As companies incorporate artificial intelligence (AI) into core operations, many are becoming dependent on vendors they may struggle to replace. A 2026 IBM Institute for Business Value study of 1,000 senior executives found that 71% say switching their primary AI vendor or model would be difficult, while 91% do not fully understand their dependencies across vendors, models and infrastructure. Such limitations can leave businesses unprepared when providers change their models or services.
articles.titleEn: Disrupting AI Infrastructure: Vedant Dwivedi Makes the Case for Sovereign AI
summaryLinesEn: Gartner says 44% of CEOs struggle to demonstrate AI financial returns as technology becomes central to growth. gartner.com/en/newsroom/press-releases/2026-10-20-gartner-says-44-percent-of-ceos-struggle-to-demonstrate-ai-financial-returns-as-technology-becomes-central-to-growth Gartner.

Vedant Dwivedi, Chief Executive Officer of AndAI, an enterprise AI platform that helps organizations coordinate AI agents and workflows, joins host Karla Jo Helms (KJ) on the Disruption Interruption Podcast to explain why model performance, proprietary data and infrastructure ownership must be considered together.

A 2026 IBM Institute for Business Value study of 1,000 senior executives found that 71% say switching their primary AI vendor or model would be difficult, while 91% do not fully understand their dependencies across vendors, models and infrastructure.

articles.title: LG ELECTRONICS' PRISM AI WINS THREE HONORS AT 2026 AMEC AWARDS
articles.descEn: LG Electronics (LG) today announced that PRISM AI, its AI-powered communications measurement platform, has won three honors at the 2026 AMEC Global Communication Effectiveness Awards. The awards are presented by AMEC, the International Association for the Measurement and Evaluation of Communication.
articles.titleEn: LG ELECTRONICS' PRISM AI WINS THREE HONORS AT 2026 AMEC AWARDS
summaryLinesEn: Media monitoring now covers 200 countries, up from 53, and tracked brands have grown from 5 to 30.

LG's AI-Powered Platform Recognized for Measuring the Real-World Impact of Communications LG Electronics' PRISM AI has won Gold in the Best Use of AI in Communication Measurement category and Silver in both the Best Use of a Measurement Framework category and the Step Change Award at the 2026 AMEC Global Communication Effectiveness Awards.

"Winning three AMEC Awards for PRISM AI is especially meaningful, not only because it highlights our efforts in advancing AI-powered communications measurement, but also because the recognition comes directly from the PR industry's most respected global body," said Cho Jung-bum, head of the AX Center at LG Electronics.

articles.title: AI生成の偽情報、見抜ける？ 「自信あり」は約3割に低下--ドコモ調査
articles.descEn: NTTドコモ モバイル社会研究所は11月12日、生成AIを知っている15～69歳を対象に、AI製の偽情報に「自信がある」「やや自信がある」と答えた人の合計が、テキスト、画像、動画のいずれも1年前から低下し、2026年は3割前後になったとの調査結果を発表した。
articles.titleEn: AI生成の偽情報、見抜ける？ 「自信あり」は約3割に低下--ドコモ調査
summaryLinesEn: 自信がある」と「やや自信がある」を合わせた割合は、文章が2025年の35.4％から2026年は27.6％、画像が37.7％から31.5％、動画が36.8％から30.8％へ低下した。
また、2025年と2026年で回答者が異なるため、同じ人の自信が1年間で低下したことを示すものでもない。
2023年以前から生成AIを知っていた人では、文章が32.7％、画像が36.9％、動画が36.3％だったのに対し、2025～2026年に知った人ではそれぞれ22.7％、25.2％、25.0％だった。

articles.title: Hugging Face CEO vows to keep fighting for open source AI after Jensen Huang's exit
articles.descEn: Hugging Face's CEO pledged to keep fighting for open source AI after Huang's exit, raising questions about Nvidia's $12.9 billion acquisition.
articles.titleEn: Hugging Face CEO vows to keep fighting for open source AI after Jensen Huang's exit
summaryLinesEn: Nvidia had announced its plan to acquire the platform for open source AI models in September for $12.9 billion, making it the second-largest acquisition in the company’s history, just behind that of chipmaker Groq’s assets for $20 billion in December 2025.

Last month, Nvidia expanded its Nemotron family of open-weight models with a large 120-billion-parameter model for agents used by the enterprise as well as with two new lightweight Bolt models that run on PCs.

Open models strengthen safety and cybersecurity, accelerate innovation and diffusion, and enable sovereignty.… pic.twitter.com/t02bi51N4C In August, Nvidia also announced a $6 billion deal with the coding startup Poolside to help build out an open AI ecosystem in the U.S. to help the country compete against Chinese companies like DeepSeek and Kimi K3, The Wall Street Journal reported at the time.

localization.title: Hugging Face CEO, Jensen Huang 퇴임 후에도 오픈 소스 AI를 위해 계속 싸울 것이라고 맹세
summaryLines: 엔비디아는 지난 9월 오픈소스 AI 모델용 플랫폼을 129억 달러에 인수하겠다는 계획을 발표했는데, 이는 2025년 12월 칩 제조사 그로크(Groq)의 자산 200억 달러에 이어 회사 역사상 두 번째로 큰 인수가 됨
지난 달 Nvidia는 기업에서 사용하는 에이전트를 위한 대규모 1,200억 매개변수 모델과 PC에서 실행되는 두 가지 새로운 경량 Bolt 모델을 통해 개방형 모델 Nemotron 제품군을 확장함

개방형 모델은 안전과 사이버 보안을 강화하고 혁신과 확산을 가속화하며 주권을 활성화함 · pic.twitter.com/t02bi51N4C 또한 지난 8월 Nvidia는 미국에서 DeepSeek 및 Kimi K3와 같은 중국 기업과 경쟁할 수 있도록 개방형 AI 생태계를 구축하는 데 도움이 되도록 코딩 스타트업 Poolside와 60억 달러 규모의 계약을 발표했다고 당시 Wall Street Journal이 보도함

articles.title: No, AI agents did not discover a previously unknown Maya site
articles.descEn: Scientists are getting tired of amateurs parachuting into their fields and making ‘discoveries’ with AI.
articles.titleEn: No, AI agents did not discover a previously unknown Maya site
summaryLinesEn: Miotti, who described the research to The Verge as a personal side project done without any Google compute or resources, said he then reached out to Mexico’s National Institute of Anthropology and History (INAH) to check whether the apparent discovery was already known, including through unpublished research.

Ultimately, amateur use of AI tools often ends up shifting the burden of establishing what has actually been found and why it matters to actual experts, work that would ordinarily be part of making a scientific discovery in the first place.

He added that as a non-archaeologist, he had not realized a site not being registered wasn’t the same as it not having been mapped, adding that expert knowledge “is needed to verify what the agents find.”

summaryLines: 더 버지(The Verge)에 이 연구를 구글 컴퓨팅이나 리소스 없이 수행된 개인 부차 프로젝트라고 설명한 미오티(Miotti)는 그런 다음 멕시코 국립 인류학 역사 연구소(INAH)에 연락하여 미발표 연구를 포함하여 명백한 발견이 이미 알려져 있는지 확인했다고 말함
궁극적으로 AI 도구를 아마추어로 사용하면 실제로 발견된 내용과 그것이 실제 전문가에게 중요한 이유를 확립하는 부담이 이전되는 경우가 많음 · 이는 일반적으로 애초에 과학적 발견을 수행하는 데 필요한 작업임
그는 고고학자가 아닌 사람으로서 등록되지 않은 유적지가 지도에 표시되지 않은 것과 같지 않다는 사실을 깨닫지 못했다고 덧붙였음 · 그는 "요원이 찾은 것을 확인하려면 전문 지식이 필요합니다"라고 덧붙였음

articles.title: Claude Meetings lets Anthropic's AI join your video calls
articles.descEn: Anthropic is adding Claude directly to video calls. Claude Meetings joins Google Meet sessions and creates documents, whiteboards, and meeting notes in real time. The feature launches in beta for Team and Enterprise plans, with more platforms coming later.
articles.titleEn: Claude Meetings lets Anthropic's AI join your video calls
summaryLinesEn: Anthropic has launched Claude Meetings, a feature that puts Claude into video calls as a visible participant.
Ad Claude Meetings extends recently announced capabilities like whiteboards and data dashboards that are gradually reshaping the Claude app into an all-in-one office tool.
Privacy controls prevent Claude from joining calls with external participants by default.

articles.title: Google's Gemini 4 Hydrogen outscores the bigger Argon just four weeks after its launch
articles.descEn: Google's Gemini 4 Hydrogen replaces the Flash series, but benchmarks suggest it also makes the pricier Argon obsolete. On the independent Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index, Hydrogen nearly matches Claude Sonnet 5.5 for less money but costs about 2.5 times more per task than GPT-6.1 Sol and still falls short on agentic coding.
articles.titleEn: Google's Gemini 4 Hydrogen outscores the bigger Argon just four weeks after its launch
summaryLinesEn: According to Google, Hydrogen beats the larger Argon on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index at the default "high" thinking level (51 vs. 50) and reaches up to 54 at the highest level, "xhigh."
For multimodal knowledge work like summarizing large PDFs, spreadsheets, or videos, Hydrogen supports up to one million output tokens on top of its one-million-token input window.
Google says it takes first place on the Vals Tax Agent Bench with 52.3 percent and ties for first on the Vals Legal Research Bench with 55.8 percent.

articles.title: Vertiv Holdings Co (VRT) Debuts PowerNexus MV UPS For AI Data Centers
articles.descEn: Vertiv Holdings Co (NYSE:VRT) introduced the PowerNexus MV UPS, a medium-voltage power system for AI data centers, focusing on grid integration and outdoor deployment. The PowerNexus MV UPS is designed for use with long-duration battery systems, targeting power-hungry AI compute clusters that strain existing electrical infrastructure. Vertiv plans a dedicated laboratory for PowerNexus MV UPS research and testing, with the goal of refining grid connectivity and outdoor performance for AI...

articles.title: SoftBank’s billion-dollar loss may have put a cap on AI's natural gas ambitions
articles.descEn: SoftBank lost over $3 billion pre-ordering natural gas turbines to power AI data centers. Here's what the loss means to power markets.
articles.titleEn: SoftBank’s billion-dollar loss may have put a cap on AI's natural gas ambitions
summaryLinesEn: SoftBank announced a $7.1 billion quarterly loss on Tuesday, with over half of that stemming from losses related to power-generating equipment.
Starting about two years ago, SoftBank reportedly put down deposits on more than 13 gigawatts of turbines, almost 50% more than it needed.
Witness its $30 billion bet on OpenAI in early 2025 or its announcement in February that its SB Energy subsidiary would spend $33 billion on a 9.2-gigawatt natural gas power plant.

articles.title: Google Deepmind shifts genomics AI from bulk tissue predictions to single cell type resolution with AlphaGenome 2
articles.descEn: Google Deepmind has unveiled AlphaGenome 2, an AI model that analyzes genetic variants for individual cell types rather than across bulk tissue. Trained on more than 107 million cell profiles, it identifies nearly twice as many disease-relevant gene changes as its predecessor. The model is available for noncommercial research through an API and is set to be integrated into Google's agentic platform Antigravity.
articles.titleEn: Google Deepmind shifts genomics AI from bulk tissue predictions to single cell type resolution with AlphaGenome 2
summaryLinesEn: AlphaGenome 2 pinpoints disease genes and vaccine responses more accurately On the TenK10K benchmark dataset with 28 primary immune cell types, AlphaGenome 2 identified about 30 percent of causal variants.
Google Deepmind has introduced AlphaGenome 2, an AI model that predicts gene changes in specific human cell types.
It was trained on more than 107 million individual cell profiles from 68 tissues, according to Google Deepmind , and is meant to help researchers uncover the cellular drivers of disease.

articles.title: Clipto enables ChatGPT and Claude to search and analyze years of people's meetings and video calls - SiliconANGLE
articles.descEn: Clipto enables ChatGPT and Claude to search and analyze years of people's meetings and video calls - SiliconANGLE
articles.titleEn: Clipto enables ChatGPT and Claude to search and analyze years of people's meetings and video calls - SiliconANGLE
summaryLinesEn: For instance, a management consultant could ask ChatGPT to pinpoint the exact time when a project’s scope changed by looking at more than six month’s worth of calls and meetings, and it will surface the exact moment when that occurred.

It’s this shortcoming that a startup called Clipto Inc. is trying to solve with the launch of a new AI chatbot memory platform called Clipto Studio, which enables AI assistants to listen in on calls, presentations and meetings and search through them or analyze them upon request.
We’re building the technology to make video and audio as accessible and as useful to AI as text, opening up an entirely new generation of applications.”

summaryLinesEn: A recent Gartner Inc. survey of business leaders found that 85% of respondents plan to step up their AI spending in the next year, but at the same time, only 22% say they have managed to scale the technology across multiple business units.
The round was led by Planven and saw participation from backers including Exor Ventures, Tenacity Capital, TGVG Capital, Fastweb, Vodafone and CDP Venture Capital’s Digital Transition Fund.
Planven’s Giovanni Canetta Roeder said he’s backing Nebuly because he’s convinced that every large organization is going to need a way to measure AI’s return on investment.

articles.title: 3 ways AI is changing the healthcare revenue cycle - SiliconANGLE
articles.descEn: AI agents are changing the healthcare revenue cycle. Leaders from Mount Sinai, RUSH and Panoramic Health discuss claims, staff and oversight.
articles.titleEn: 3 ways AI is changing the healthcare revenue cycle - SiliconANGLE
summaryLinesEn: For Mount Sinai Health System Inc. , that starts with clear workflows and accountability when automation encounters an exception, according to Salonia Brown , system vice president of revenue cycle at Mount Sinai.
The healthcare revenue cycle depends on teams investigating denied claims, checking payer rules and deciding which problems need a human’s attention.
At Rush University System for Health, frontline employees help identify time-consuming steps that add little value, according to Blake Evans , system vice president of revenue cycle at Rush.

articles.title: AI chatbots are recommending fake retail websites, study finds
articles.descEn: AI tools including Gemini, ChatGPT, and Perplexity are showing shoppers fake or risky websites when they ask about where to buy products, a study by IP protection firm Podqi found.
articles.titleEn: AI chatbots are recommending fake retail websites, study finds
summaryLinesEn: Follow Follow See All AI A study testing Gemini, Perplexity, and ChatGPT found that in as many as 15 percent of conversations, chatbots displayed ‘risky’ URLs.
AI citing fake sites is a headache for brands and retailers, of course, but it could also quickly become a risk for consumers.
Shoppers using AI chatbots to research products or find places to buy items could be directed to imposters and other risky websites, a new study found.

articles.title: Google’s new Gemini model is better at understanding complicated questions
articles.descEn: Google launched Gemini 4 Hydrogen, available starting Thursday in search, AI Mode, and the Gemini app.
articles.titleEn: Google’s new Gemini model is better at understanding complicated questions
summaryLinesEn: The new model can break down your questions and address each part in its responses.

According to Google, the new model “delivers significant leaps in both speed and intelligence” compared to Gemini Flash 3.8 , and it “matches or outperforms some of the competing models in its class,” like Claude Sonnet 5.5 and GPT-6.1 Terra.
Google says its new Gemini 4 Hydrogen model can give more helpful answers to complex questions, including “questions with multiple parts, hard-to-understand typos, or highly specific requests.”

localization.title: Google의 새로운 Gemini 모델은 복잡한 질문을 더 잘 이해함
summaryLines: 새로운 모델은 질문을 세분화하고 답변의 각 부분을 다룰 수 있음

Google은 새로운 Gemini 4 Hydrogen 모델이 "여러 부분이 포함된 질문, 이해하기 어려운 오타 또는 매우 구체적인 요청"을 포함하여 복잡한 질문에 더 유용한 답변을 제공할 수 있다고 말함

articles.title: Nectar launches an AI agent to automate creator discovery and outreach for brands
articles.descEn: Nectar's new AI agent automates influencer marketing, helping brands discover creators, manage outreach and partnerships, and track campaign results.
articles.titleEn: Nectar launches an AI agent to automate creator discovery and outreach for brands
summaryLinesEn: Nectar says its Creator Agent searches more than 300 million creator profiles to find potential partners, including smaller creators who may not yet have a large following but are gaining traction.
This past May, Nectar raised a $30 million Series A round led by Menlo Ventures and its Anthology Fund, which is a joint initiative launched with Anthropic.

Founded by sisters Misbah and Farah Uraizee, both former Meta employees, Nectar came out of stealth last year and uses AI agents to help brands manage social media, customer conversations, content moderation, creator partnerships, and competitor research.

summaryLines: Nectar는 자사의 크리에이터 에이전트가 잠재적인 파트너를 찾기 위해 3억 개 이상의 크리에이터 프로필을 검색한다고 밝힘 · 여기에는 아직 팔로어가 많지는 않지만 관심을 끌고 있는 소규모 크리에이터도 포함됨

전직 Meta 직원이었던 Misbah와 Farah Uraizee 자매가 설립한 Nectar는 지난해 비밀에서 벗어나 AI 에이전트를 사용하여 브랜드가 소셜 미디어, 고객 대화, 콘텐츠 조정, 제작자 파트너십 및 경쟁사 연구를 관리하도록 돕음

summaryLinesEn: The 11-inch iPad Pro with the M5 chip and 1TB of storage is down to $1,499.99 on Amazon .

articles.title: Qualcomm CEO: AI won't replace your smartphone anytime soon
articles.descEn: Qualcomm CEO Cristiano Amon says how you use your phone will change because of AI.
articles.titleEn: Qualcomm CEO: AI won't replace your smartphone anytime soon
summaryLinesEn: Why bond king Jeffrey Gundlach is steering clear of the AI 'blast radius' 'Banks are probably getting hacked left and right': Binance founder Changpeng Zhao Reddit CEO Steve Huffman explains the 'paradox' of AI for his company Across the entire 2026 fiscal year, smartphone sales accounted for $24.07 billion of the company's $37.21 billion total semiconductor revenue.

They're going to operate the phone for you, and eventually, certain workloads, you're going to relegate to the agent," he said, adding that phones will "play a very important processing hub for a lot of the content and the sensing, even as workloads shift to glasses and other personal AI devices.
But smartphone processor revenue dropped 26% year over year to $5.14 billion in its fiscal fourth quarter due to industrywide memory shortages and Apple's ( AAPL ) transition toward in-house modems.

localization.title: Qualcomm CEO: AI가 조만간 스마트폰을 대체하지는 않을 것임
summaryLines: 채권왕 Jeffrey Gundlach가 AI '폭발 반경'을 피하는 이유 '은행은 아마도 좌우로 해킹당할 것입니다': Binance 창립자 Changpeng Zhao Reddit CEO Steve Huffman은 자신의 회사에 대한 AI의 '역설'을 설명함 · 2026 회계연도 전체에 걸쳐 스마트폰 판매는 회사의 총 반도체 매출 372억 1천만 달러 중 240억 7천만 달러를 차지함
그들은 당신을 위해 전화를 작동하게 될 것이며 결국 특정 작업 부하를 에이전트에게 위임하게 될 것임" · 라고 그는 말함 · "작업 부하가 안경 및 기타 개인 AI 장치로 이동하더라도 전화는 많은 콘텐츠와 감지에 대해 매우 중요한 처리 허브 역할을 할 것임
그러나 스마트폰 프로세서 수익은 업계 전반의 메모리 부족과 Apple(AAPL)의 자체 모뎀 전환으로 인해 회계연도 4분기에 전년 동기 대비 26% 감소한 51억 4천만 달러를 기록함

summaryLinesEn: Clinicians across more than 300 enterprise health systems representing over 250 million patients have adopted the Abridge Assistant since its launch earlier this year.

summaryLines: 2억 5천만 명 이상의 환자를 대표하는 300개가 넘는 기업 의료 시스템의 임상의들은 올해 초 출시된 Abridge Assistant를 채택함
올해 이 플랫폼은 미국에서 가장 크고 복잡한 300개 이상의 의료 시스템 전반에 걸쳐 1억 2천만 명 이상의 환자와 임상의의 만남을 지원할 것임
2018년에 설립된 Abridge는 환자를 중심으로 구성된 최초의 AI 기반 임상의 인텔리전스 플랫폼으로, 임상의를 위해 구축되었으며 의료 시스템이 모든 치료 순간에 대한 임상, 재정 및 증거 기반 결정을 조정할 수 있도록 설계됨

articles.descEn: Google Ads introduces the Invalid Traffic Overview Card for campaign transparency. See your savings and credits from November 2026. Get the details.
articles.titleEn: We’re introducing a new transparency tool for invalid traffic in Google Ads.
summaryLinesEn: So far in 2026, we’ve reduced advertiser exposure to invalid leads by an average of 30% through continuous system upgrades.

We’ve long built defenses directly into our ad systems to block invalid traffic, helping businesses get the most out of their budgets and spend with confidence.

articles.title: The Dating Attitudes of Single Black Adults
articles.descEn: While about half of Black singles are looking for a relationship or dates, men and women differ on goals and financial considerations.
articles.titleEn: The Dating Attitudes of Single Black Adults
summaryLinesEn: It also provides an estimate of the share of Black Americans who are single.

A previous report based on the same survey explores how Black Americans define and experience family , and another recent report describes what factors influence Black Americans’ views on what it means to be a Black man or Black woman .
The sample included 4,271 Black adults, with 1,057 respondents who are members of Pew Research Center’s American Trends Panel and 3,214 respondents who are members of SSRS’s Opinion Panel.

localization.title: 미혼 흑인 성인의 데이트 태도
summaryLines: 또한 미혼 흑인의 비율에 대한 추정치를 제공함
동일한 설문 조사를 기반으로 한 이전 보고서에서는 흑인 미국인이 가족을 어떻게 정의하고 경험하는지 탐구하고, 또 다른 최근 보고서에서는 흑인 남성 또는 흑인 여성이 된다는 것이 무엇을 의미하는지에 대한 흑인 미국인의 견해에 어떤 요인이 영향을 미치는지 설명함
표본에는 4,271명의 흑인 성인이 포함되었으며, 그 중 1,057명은 Pew Research Center의 미국 동향 패널 회원이고 3,214명은 SSRS 의견 패널 회원임

articles.title: How Block powers collaborative AI agents with Buzz and Unity Gateway | Databricks Blog
articles.descEn: Inside Block, Buzz brings employees and AI agents into a shared workspace. With Databricks Unity Gateway, employees who use Buzz can access frontier and open-weight models, experiment with different agent harnesses, and find the right combination based on the efficiency frontier for each task.
articles.titleEn: How Block powers collaborative AI agents with Buzz and Unity Gateway | Databricks Blog
summaryLinesEn: As an open source project, Buzz is model-agnostic and can be self-hosted, meaning it can run privately on your own network or system, giving users flexibility in how they deploy and configure their agents.

With Databricks Unity Gateway, employees who use Buzz can access frontier and open-weight models, experiment with different agent harnesses, and find the right combination based on the efficiency frontier for each task.
At Block, Databricks Unity Gateway helps power the Buzz experience by providing access to a broad selection of frontier and open-weight models through a single integration.

localization.title: Block이 Buzz 및 Unity Gateway를 통해 협업 AI 에이전트를 강화하는 방법 | 데이터브릭스 블로그
summaryLines: 오픈 소스 프로젝트인 Buzz는 모델에 구애받지 않고 자체 호스팅이 가능함 · 즉, 자체 네트워크나 시스템에서 비공개로 실행될 수 있어 사용자가 에이전트를 배포하고 구성하는 방법에 유연성을 제공함
Buzz를 사용하는 직원은 Databricks Unity Gateway를 사용하여 프론티어 및 개방형 모델에 액세스하고, 다양한 에이전트 하네스를 실험하고, 각 작업의 효율성 프론티어를 기반으로 올바른 조합을 찾을 수 있음

articles.descEn: Agents stall between demo and release when teams lack a repeatable way to measure how good an agent is and whether the last change helped. This post covers three agent properties that break traditional CI/CD, a measured case where an aggregate metric hides a coverage gap, and Agent DLC: one lifecycle, two loops, and one explicit standard for judging every change.

articles.title: Fine-grained access control for Amazon Bedrock Managed Knowledge Base tools | Amazon Web Services
articles.descEn: Learn how to expose an Amazon Bedrock Managed Knowledge Base to AI agents as MCP tools through Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway while keeping per-user access control. A request interceptor injects verified identity, Policy in AgentCore validates it independently, and a resource-based policy restricts direct access to the knowledge base.
articles.titleEn: Fine-grained access control for Amazon Bedrock Managed Knowledge Base tools | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: If you replace the departments with customer companies, the same problem occurs in a multi-tenant software as a service (SaaS) architecture where multiple customers share one assistant and knowledge base.
If you adapt the pattern to an existing Amazon Cognito user pool, the user pool must be on the Essentials or Plus feature plan, which access token customization requires.
All employees share the same agent and knowledge base, yet each employee can search only the documents they’re allowed to view.

articles.title: Build composable, interoperable multi-agent systems with A2A on AWS | Amazon Web Services
articles.descEn: Build a composable, interoperable multi-agent system on AWS with the Agent-to-Agent (A2A) protocol. A LangChain orchestrator on Amazon ECS communicates with a Strands agent on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore across organizational boundaries, using bidirectional, OAuth-authenticated calls, with neither side depending on the other's framework or SDK.
articles.titleEn: Build composable, interoperable multi-agent systems with A2A on AWS | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: A Jupyter environment with Python 3.10 or later, either: On your computer: JupyterLab, the AWS Command Line Interface (AWS CLI) version 2 , and an AWS IAM Identity Center profile for each account, set up with aws configure sso .
In Open Protocols for Agent Interoperability Part 4: Inter-Agent Communication on A2A , we introduced A2A concepts and demonstrated two Strands agents communicating using the protocol on AWS.
Agents in multi-agent systems that span organizational boundaries often need to collaborate in a composable, interoperable way, with agents that other organizations build and run.

articles.title: Scaling AI value without losing control: Lessons from Frontier Firms - The Official Microsoft Blog
articles.descEn: Results are widespread. Value at scale is not, and that gap is what this year’s research from IDC, commissioned by Microsoft, set out to explain. In our fourth year commissioning IDC, more than 5,200 senior IT and business leaders across 28 industries shared what it takes to maximize value as AI scales. The clearest lessons...
articles.titleEn: Scaling AI value without losing control: Lessons from Frontier Firms - The Official Microsoft Blog
summaryLinesEn: Black & Veatch reached 98% adoption of Microsoft 365 Copilot through deliberate change management, including early-adopter cohorts that surfaced real business use cases.
The clearest lessons come from Frontier Firms, the group last year’s research introduced: the top 10% of organizations on IDC’s AI maturity scale.
The lesson from Frontier Firms is one I believe every leader can act on: scaling AI value means managing models, agents, governance and measurement as one accountable system.

articles.title: Migrate to Amazon Bedrock Managed Knowledge Base with your coding agent | Amazon Web Services
articles.descEn: The migration guide in the amazon-bedrock skill helps you migrate a customer-managed Amazon Bedrock knowledge base to a Managed Knowledge Base. Your coding agent plans the move with read-only discovery, creates the new knowledge base or an infrastructure-as-code template alongside the original, and validates retrieval before you cut over.
articles.titleEn: Migrate to Amazon Bedrock Managed Knowledge Base with your coding agent | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: With a customer-managed knowledge base on Amazon Bedrock , you provision and scale the vector store, tune the embedding model and index settings, and plan capacity for each new data source.
A Managed Knowledge Base is priced on what you store and retrieve, so cost follows real usage.
In Explore mode, your agent answers questions about Managed Knowledge Base and can inspect your configuration with read-only calls, so you can estimate the effort.

articles.title: Lakehouse//RT: Scale real-time analytics, not your bill | Databricks Blog
articles.descEn: Lakehouse//RT is built to absorb growing real-time query volume without a matching jump in cost, and to replace separate real-time serving stacks.
articles.titleEn: Lakehouse//RT: Scale real-time analytics, not your bill | Databricks Blog
summaryLinesEn: And with growing demand for use cases like customer-facing dashboards that refresh in milliseconds and applications with embedded analytics, real-time workloads are quickly becoming a standard part of how businesses use data.

Lakehouse//RT is intentionally built to absorb that demand without a proportional cost increase Customers that chose Lakehouse//RT over separate real-time serving layers report 6x to 10x lower infrastructure costs AI agents are pushing the limits of data warehouses.
And even when a warehouse can deliver low latency, the bill grows as fast as demand: 10x the queries could easily mean 10x the cost.

Lakehouse//RT는 비례적인 비용 증가 없이 해당 수요를 흡수하도록 의도적으로 구축됨 · 별도의 실시간 서비스 계층 대신 Lakehouse//RT를 선택한 고객은 인프라 비용이 6~10배 더 낮다고 보고함 · AI 에이전트는 데이터 웨어하우스의 한계를 뛰어넘고 있음
그리고 창고가 짧은 대기 시간을 제공할 수 있더라도 청구서는 수요만큼 빠르게 증가함 · 즉, 쿼리가 10배 증가하면 비용이 10배 증가할 수 있음

articles.title: How H6.ai builds AI-powered financial automation with Lakebase Postgres | Databricks Blog
articles.descEn: H6.ai tests every change to its invoice-processing AI against frozen copies of real customer databases. Each copy is a Lakebase Postgres branch. It holds the exact financial state behind a real invoice, and we can replay it as often as we like without touching the customer's live data.
articles.titleEn: How H6.ai builds AI-powered financial automation with Lakebase Postgres | Databricks Blog
summaryLinesEn: Traditional accounts payable and invoice processing tools often force companies into a trade-off: moving quickly using AI automation and risk losing control, or maintaining tedious manual oversight.
H6.ai gives every customer a dedicated Lakebase Postgres database, which keeps each customer's financial data isolated on a multi-tenant AP automation platform.
It is how we build AI-powered financial automation that customers can trust.

articles.title: We're launching a $10 million Energy Impact Program in West Virginia.
articles.descEn: Google is launching a $10 million Energy Impact Program in West Virginia to fund home repairs and efficiency upgrades. Check your eligibility today.
articles.titleEn: We're launching a $10 million Energy Impact Program in West Virginia.
summaryLinesEn: The first $1 million will go toward the West Virginia Office of Energy across six counties: Putnam, Kanawha, Cabell, Mason, Jackson, and Lincoln.
Many older homes require basic repairs — like fixing roof leaks or outdated wiring — before they qualify for energy upgrades.
This initiative is an early step in Google’s long-term investment in the communities near its planned Buffalo data center campus.

summaryLinesEn: Advancing research and partnering with universities in Singapore We’ve received our first response from the Project Suncatcher prototype satellite.
As COP31 kicks off this week, we’re sharing results from our partnership with Australia's national science agency, CSIRO , which is using AI and genomics to help restore giant kelp .

articles.title: From “...and?” to “ah-ha!”: How to discover powerful generative AI use cases for your marketing team
articles.descEn: Maximize generative AI's potential by strategically identifying, prioritizing, and implementing use cases in marketing.
articles.titleEn: From “...and?” to “ah-ha!”: How to discover powerful generative AI use cases for your marketing team
summaryLinesEn: If you log into LinkedIn, or a community forum, or listen to a webinar or podcast, you’ll receive an endless supply of generative AI use cases.
Without a framework for identifying and prioritizing use cases, marketing teams can’t operationalize and scale their use of generative AI.
Generative AI is disrupting industries at a rapid pace, and marketing teams need to plan for continuous use case adoption.

sourceContent.description: Learn how nurse practitioner Olivia Taylor at Deaconess Health is using Abridge's context-aware decision support in her practice.
paragraphs: We sat down with Olivia Taylor, a psychiatric mental health nurse practitioner at Deaconess Health with a decade of experience across both inpatient and outpatient care.
And if you're curious how Abridge's context-aware decision support could fit into your workflow, head to the CDS page on our website to learn more.
What has having decision support within Abridge changed for you about practicing medicine?

Psychiatric care requires a high degree of personalization that balances clinical rigor with a respect for humanity. Clinicians need deep knowledge of medications, interactions, and treatment approaches while continually assessing what patients report and how their symptoms, behavior, and functioning change over time. Treatment decisions depend on bringing together the patient’s story and the latest evidence, with room for adjustment at any time.

Abridge's clinical intelligence provides evidence at the point of care, contextualized to the patient in the room. It leverages the patient conversation alongside information from the electronic health record—including prior notes, labs, diagnoses, and other chart data—to shape the evidence it surfaces during care. No switching tabs. No digging for labs. Just evidence-based insights, tailored to each patient's clinical situation, now implemented enterprise-wide at more than 300 health systems.

We sat down with Olivia Taylor, a psychiatric mental health nurse practitioner at Deaconess Health with a decade of experience across both inpatient and outpatient care. In our conversation, she shared how Abridge's clinical intelligence has changed her day-to-day workflow, a recent example of how she used it with a patient to support her recommendation on tapering a medication, and the relief she experienced after a day of helping people through “some of the hardest moments of their lives.”

In high-pressure care settings like the emergency department, time and information are everything, but in scarce supply. Clinicians must immediately assess problems and make decisions, all while new patients continue to arrive. There is rarely time to consult all of the latest, most-relevant literature and guidance. And new evidence is published at an impossible clip.

Abridge's clinical intelligence provides evidence at the point of care, contextualized to the patient in the room. It leverages the patient conversation alongside information from the electronic health record—including prior notes, labs, diagnoses, and other chart data—to shape the evidence it surfaces during care. No switching tabs. No digging for labs. Just evidence-based insights, tailored to each patient's clinical situation, now implemented enterprise-wide at more than 300 health systems.

We sat down with Dr. Brian Dilcher, an emergency medicine clinician and associate Chief Medical Information Officer (CMIO) for emergency medicine at WVU Medicine’s Ruby Memorial Hospital in West Virginia. As an informatics leader, he decides whether technologies like Abridge are rigorous enough to meet the needs of fellow clinicians and residents. As a practicing clinician, he's also the one using it, so he has a personal stake. In our conversation, he shared how he’s using Abridge’s clinical intelligence in his own practice and how it's earned his trust as both a clinician and an informatics leader.

The question isn't whether clinicians will use AI for clinical guidance. It's whether that AI has been rigorously evaluated for enterprise readiness.

AI is already in the exam room. Clinicians are querying large language models for drug interactions, differential diagnoses, and treatment guidance; with the AMA reporting that nearly 40% of surveyed clinicians use AI for summaries of research and standards of care. However, this may be done with limited visibility into how those systems were built, tested, or constrained. The tools exist. The adoption is happening. The missing piece, in most cases, is the evaluation rigor that should precede clinician usage.
At Abridge, we believe that enterprise AI in healthcare must be trustworthy at scale, and that starts with being transparent about our evaluation processes and guardrails.

sourceContent.description: Learn how internal medicine-pediatrics clinician Kristin Jacob at Corewell Health is using the Abridge Assistant.
paragraphs: Built by clinicians and machine learning scientists working side by side, it's trained to weigh what matters the way a clinician would: the allergy that rules out a drug, the family history that moves a screening up, the guideline exception this patient meets.
As a practicing primary care clinician, she's using the Abridge Assistant's context-aware decision support across her own workflow.
In our conversation, she shared how the Abridge Assistant has transformed her practice before, during, and after visits, and where she sees Abridge having the greatest impact.

Primary care requires clinicians to have an enormous range of knowledge. A single day's schedule might run from seeing a newborn for their first checkup to managing a chronic condition for a geriatric patient, and each carries its own set of guidelines, screening intervals, and medication considerations. Much of the work of preparing for that day happens outside of the exam room.

The Abridge Assistant brings contextual clinical reasoning to the point of care. Built by clinicians and machine learning scientists working side by side, it's trained to weigh what matters the way a clinician would: the allergy that rules out a drug, the family history that moves a screening up, the guideline exception this patient meets. It draws on the conversation, the chart, and trusted medical literature to deliver evidence-based responses without pulling you out of your workflow. Now live across more than 300 health systems, and getting sharper with every capability clinicians ask for.

We recently sat down with Dr. Kristin Jacob, an internal medicine-pediatrics clinician and Medical Director of Physician and APP Well-Being at Corewell Health. As a practicing primary care clinician, she's using the Abridge Assistant's context-aware decision support across her own workflow. As a well-being leader, she's also thinking about how to bring it to the colleagues who stand to benefit most. In our conversation, she shared how the Abridge Assistant has transformed her practice before, during, and after visits, and where she sees Abridge having the greatest impact.

articles.title: Introducing Gemini 4 Hydrogen
articles.descEn: Google introduces Gemini 4 Hydrogen, a fast, cost-efficient model built for reliable agentic workflows and everyday tasks. Get the details.
articles.titleEn: Introducing Gemini 4 Hydrogen
summaryLinesEn: Gemini 4 Hydrogen is priced flat across its entire 1 million-token context window at $1.50 per million input tokens and $7.50 per million output tokens.

For workflows that require parallel agents, Carbon can act as the coordinator while Hydrogen can power worker and verifier agents to build and test changes simultaneously across isolated workspaces — helping teams ship complex projects faster without driving up token costs.

To explore large repositories efficiently, the model excels at natively batching file-read and search calls in parallel rather than inspecting files one by one; in early testing across complex graphs, SQL, and data-heavy enterprise workflows, our partners have seen Hydrogen run 2x to 2.8x faster while reducing token usage by 12% to 23%, compared to 3.8 Flash.

localization.title: Gemini 4 수소 소개
summaryLines: Gemini 4 Hydrogen의 가격은 100만 개 토큰 컨텍스트 창 전체에 걸쳐 입력 토큰 100만 개당 1.50달러, 출력 토큰 100만 개당 7.50달러로 균일하게 책정됨
병렬 에이전트가 필요한 워크플로의 경우 Carbon은 코디네이터 역할을 할 수 있고, Hydrogen은 작업자와 검증자 에이전트가 격리된 작업 공간에서 변경 사항을 동시에 구축하고 테스트할 수 있도록 지원하여 팀이 토큰 비용을 들이지 않고도 복잡한 프로젝트를 더 빠르게 출시할 수 있도록 돕음

대규모 리포지토리를 효율적으로 탐색하기 위해 이 모델은 파일을 하나씩 검사하는 대신 기본적으로 파일 읽기 및 검색 호출을 병렬로 일괄 처리하는 데 탁월함 · 복잡한 그래프, SQL 및 데이터 집약적인 기업 워크플로에 대한 초기 테스트에서 파트너는 Hydrogen이 3.8 Flash에 비해 토큰 사용량을 12%~23% 줄이면서 2배~2.8배 더 빠르게 실행되는 것을 확인함

articles.title: Building a self-service LLM gateway with Amazon Bedrock and LiteLLM | Amazon Web Services
articles.descEn: Build a self-service LLM gateway with LiteLLM on AWS Fargate that puts Amazon Bedrock foundation models behind an OpenAI-compatible API. Developers get instant access through a single API key, while platform teams gain per-user cost controls, quota isolation, and observability.
articles.titleEn: Building a self-service LLM gateway with Amazon Bedrock and LiteLLM | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: With a large language model (LLM) gateway and LiteLLM, they can quickly access foundation models (FMs) available on Amazon Bedrock while you gain visibility and usage control.
You will need an AWS account, Amazon Bedrock model access, and appropriate IAM permissions to deploy this project.
When LiteLLM calls the inference profile ARN, Amazon Bedrock routes to available capacity across configured AWS Regions and returns the response.

articles.title: Optimizing cost per task and proving agent ROI on Amazon Bedrock | Amazon Web Services
articles.descEn: Comparing per-token prices hides the real cost of running a model on Amazon Bedrock. This post shows how to calculate the true cost per task across four hidden cost drivers, reduce it with caching, routing, and output constraints, and prove agent ROI with human baselines, holdout experiments, and a five-dimension scorecard.

sourceContent.headline: Optimizing cost per task and proving agent ROI on Amazon Bedrock | Amazon Web Services
sourceContent.description: Comparing per-token prices hides the real cost of running a model on Amazon Bedrock. This post shows how to calculate the true cost per task across four hidden cost drivers, reduce it with caching, routing, and output constraints, and prove agent ROI with human baselines, holdout experiments, and a five-dimension scorecard.

summaryLinesEn: We report robustness, defined as 1 − attack success rate: the share of attacks where the model does not carry out the injected instruction.

articles.title: Eclipse Aerospace simplifies flight-data ingestion with Databricks | Databricks Blog
articles.descEn: See how Eclipse Aerospace partnered with Databricks to modernize flight data processing, saving time and costs while making decades of telemetry easier to use.
articles.titleEn: Eclipse Aerospace simplifies flight-data ingestion with Databricks | Databricks Blog
summaryLinesEn: Eclipse Aerospace relies on Databricks to store nearly 20 years of flight data, totalling more than 3TB.

It supports its service centers and engineers with data from more than a million flight hours, sourced and verified across multiple sources, including: near-real-time satellite telemetry; large bulk uploads of full flight histories; and external data sources.

For Eclipse Aerospace, a very light jet manufacturer and operator, partnering with Databricks offered a way to make nearly two decades of proprietary flight data more accessible to service centers and engineers without adding costly, always-on infrastructure.

summaryLinesEn: Constellation collects data from asset management, supply chain, commercial and trading systems, and operations across the fleet.

Constellation is the nation's largest producer of clean and reliable energy, with generating capacity equivalent to the needs of 27 million homes and approximately 2.5 million retail customer accounts.
On that foundation, the team is developing AI use cases for nuclear engineering, outage planning, and sales.

articles.title: Tokenomics at scale: Track and cap Amazon Bedrock spend per IAM principal with CUR 2.0 and AWS Budgets | Amazon Web Services
articles.descEn: Get per-identity Amazon Bedrock cost visibility and enforceable spend limits using only AWS-native features, with no application code for the common case. Attribute spend with IAM principal tags, report with CUR 2.0 or Cost Explorer, and enforce with AWS Budgets actions that apply a Deny policy when a threshold is crossed.
articles.titleEn: Tokenomics at scale: Track and cap Amazon Bedrock spend per IAM principal with CUR 2.0 and AWS Budgets | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: You can apply up to 50 principal or session tags per IAM user or role.

The approach relies on three things: IAM principal attribution , which Amazon Bedrock records automatically; AWS Cost and Usage Reports (CUR) 2.0 or AWS Cost Explorer for reporting; and AWS Budgets with budget actions for enforcement.
This post shows how to get per-identity Amazon Bedrock cost visibility and enforceable spend limits using only AWS-native features, with no application code to write for the common case.

articles.title: The freed-up analyst: how AI leverage becomes a sourcing advantage
articles.descEn: Discover how AI frees analyst capacity for deal sourcing in banking. Learn why governed AI and compliance guardrails turn freed time into won mandates.
articles.titleEn: The freed-up analyst: how AI leverage becomes a sourcing advantage
summaryLinesEn: Deloitte estimated that generative AI could lift front-office productivity at the world’s largest investment banks by 27% to 35% by 2026, adding roughly $3.5 million in additional revenue per front-office employee.
Solomon’s example captures the shift happening across investment banking.

( Business Insider ) When every employee can delegate work to teams of agents, the question shifts from how many analysts you need to what team members, from junior to senior, should focus on with the time that is now freed up.

articles.title: A First Look at Polling Performance in 2026
articles.descEn: Preelection polls captured the direction of this year’s election, while generally understating the size of Democrats’ advantage.
articles.titleEn: A First Look at Polling Performance in 2026
summaryLinesEn: If the average error across all types of races ends up around 4 to 5 points, it would be larger than the error for similar races in the midterm elections of 2022 and 2018, as documented by the American Association for Public Opinion Research .
In fact, preelection polling estimates understated the Democratic margin by at least 2 percentage points in 21 of 27 races for governor and U.S.
But it’s still possible to compare the total number of Republican and Democratic votes cast with preelection polling estimates.

articles.title: Four Amazon Bedrock inference choices that affect cost | Amazon Web Services
articles.descEn: Your Amazon Bedrock inference bill can keep climbing even after you tune prompts and application logic. Four request-level choices (cache duration, service tier, reasoning effort, and maxTokens) change how many tokens the service processes and the rate applied. We show how we tested each and how to verify the effect.
articles.titleEn: Four Amazon Bedrock inference choices that affect cost | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: Every Amazon Bedrock response carries usage metadata.
An application moved from Claude Sonnet 4.6 without changes starts billing thinking tokens, and maxTokens now caps thinking plus response text.
For broader decisions such as model selection, batch inference, routing, and distillation, see Effective cost optimization strategies for Amazon Bedrock .

articles.title: Introducing Claude 4
articles.descEn: Discover Claude 4's breakthrough AI capabilities. Experience more reliable, interpretable assistance for complex tasks across work and learning.
articles.titleEn: Introducing Claude 4
summaryLinesEn: To accommodate the additional steps Claude incurs by utilizing more thinking, the maximum number of steps (counted by model completions) was increased from 30 to 100 (most trajectories completed under 30 steps with only one trajectory reaching above 50 steps).
Finally, we've introduced thinking summaries for Claude 4 models that use a smaller model to condense lengthy thought processes.

New API capabilities: We’re releasing four new capabilities on our API that enable developers to build more powerful AI agents: the code execution tool, MCP connector, Files API, and the ability to cache prompts for up to one hour.

articles.title: Dispelling LTAP myths | Databricks Blog
articles.descEn: Lakebase's LTAP design makes the lake the database's storage, not a replica: one Delta or Iceberg table, one catalog, with Postgres caches and pageservers in front for speed.
articles.titleEn: Dispelling LTAP myths | Databricks Blog
summaryLinesEn: Logical replication replays every change through a pipeline that must keep up, which makes it a costly way to build the lake copy.

That is why Postgres stays fast, analytics stays fresh, and no CDC pipeline is needed Lakebase's LTAP design makes the lake the database's storage, not a replica: one Delta or Iceberg table, one catalog, with Postgres caches and pageservers in front for speed.

Four readings came up often: “A single copy of the data can have only one physical layout, so either point lookups or scans must be slow” “Iceberg or Delta tables on object storage are inherently stale”

articles.title: How DroiClaw is building an AI-native operating system for the agentic era
articles.descEn: Artificial intelligence, once a cool feature living exclusively inside your favorite app, is upgrading. Now, the shift is toward using AI as the foundation and not simply an added feature. AI is now becoming part of operating systems and amping up how we use and interact with devices. The vision: instead of requiring people to […]
articles.titleEn: How DroiClaw is building an AI-native operating system for the agentic era
summaryLinesEn: The first smartphones shipping with DroiClaw, which currently include devices from Coolpad and Philips, are priced at approximately RMB 1,099 (around US$160).
Now, the shift is toward using AI as the foundation and not simply an added feature.
DroiClaw uses a hybrid architecture that combines on-device AI with cloud-based large language models to support different usage scenarios.

articles.title: On-device AI Is ready to challenge cloud dominance
articles.descEn: UNESCO recently advocated a shift away from resource-intensive AI models in favour of more compact ones. The UNESCO report calls for governments and industry to invest in sustainable AI research and development. as a way to reduce energy consumption by up to 90%. While much of the AI industry is still obsessed with building more […]
articles.titleEn: On-device AI Is ready to challenge cloud dominance
summaryLinesEn: VisionPsy-Nano 460M-Flash is engineered for fast, real-world deployment on everyday smartphones (e.g., cutting time-to-first-response by up to 23x on a Pixel 9) while retaining around 99% of full model quality.

In the last couple of years, even the largest cloud providers have moved into compact VLMs, with Google evolving its lightweight open-weight lineup from PaliGemma in 2024 through the Gemma 3 and Gemma 4 families.

Driven by growing demand for localised user privacy, environmental concerns à la ‘tokenmaxxing’ , and efficiency required by some use cases, breakthroughs in smaller purpose-built AI models have shown developers that capable AI does not always require large cloud setups.

articles.title: Build autonomous AI agents with Amazon Bedrock and Spring AI | Amazon Web Services
articles.descEn: Learn how Java developers can build production-ready autonomous AI agents using Amazon Bedrock and Spring AI. This post walks through tool calling, conversation memory, resilience patterns, and multi-agent orchestration, then deploys the agent to AWS with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore.
articles.titleEn: Build autonomous AI agents with Amazon Bedrock and Spring AI | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: The solution consists of two deployable systems that share common patterns: Travel agent – A single autonomous agent with tool calling (weather lookups, itinerary search), streaming responses, conversation memory, and resilience patterns.

To follow along with this walkthrough, you need the following: Spring Boot – 4.1 (with Spring AI 2.0 and spring-ai-agentcore 2.0) AWS Command Line Interface (AWS CLI) – v2, configured with credentials.
Amazon Bedrock and Spring AI close those gaps, so Java teams can build autonomous AI agents that plan, call tools and APIs, and maintain context across multi-turn conversations.

This post walks through tool calling, conversation memory, resilience patterns, and multi-agent orchestration, then deploys the agent to AWS with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore.
paragraphs: The solution consists of two deployable systems that share common patterns: Travel agent – A single autonomous agent with tool calling (weather lookups, itinerary search), streaming responses, conversation memory, and resilience patterns.

To follow along with this walkthrough, you need the following: Spring Boot – 4.1 (with Spring AI 2.0 and spring-ai-agentcore 2.0) AWS Command Line Interface (AWS CLI) – v2, configured with credentials.
Amazon Bedrock and Spring AI close those gaps, so Java teams can build autonomous AI agents that plan, call tools and APIs, and maintain context across multi-turn conversations.

summaryLines: 이 솔루션은 공통 패턴을 공유하는 두 가지 배포 가능한 시스템으로 구성됨 · 여행사 – 도구 호출(날씨 조회, 일정 검색), 스트리밍 응답, 대화 메모리 및 탄력성 패턴을 갖춘 단일 자율 에이전트임

articles.title: Qualcomm CEO on tech stock meltdown: 'There is no AI correction' for us
articles.descEn: Qualcomm CEO Cristiano Amon is staying bullish on his prospects despite the tech stock meltdown.
articles.titleEn: Qualcomm CEO on tech stock meltdown: 'There is no AI correction' for us
summaryLinesEn: Qualcomm said in early September that hyperscaler Amazon ( AMZN ) ‌could buy up to $60 billion of its AI data center chips and related products under a long-term partnership.

Billionaire investor Bill Ackman on why he's staying bullish on Netflix United Airlines CEO: Starlink is our biggest competitive advantage in 100 years Bill Ackman calls Anthropic 'the most amazing business story of this century' — but he's not a buyer Qualcomm isn't exactly 100% immune from the AI infrastructure risk-off trade.
And what I said coming back to Qualcomm is we're new to this, we're being modest, and for everything that I outlined out there, I have the supply, I have the demand."

articles.title: Jensen Huang's exit from Nvidia raises critical questions about the future of AI
articles.descEn: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has been a singular figure in the development of the AI industry, which suddenly has to survive without him.
articles.titleEn: Jensen Huang's exit from Nvidia raises critical questions about the future of AI
summaryLinesEn: Follow CNBC's live coverage of Nvidia's third-quarter 2027 earnings Former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang says he's open to returning in first statement since resignation Pro: Nvidia earnings: Three things investors are watching Exclusive: How Trump traded Nvidia stock as he championed the chipmaker Nvidia has lost $2 trillion in value.
That's up 18-fold from the same quarter in 2022, just before OpenAI launched ChatGPT and kicked off the generative AI era.

summaryLinesEn: Internal Arm testing shows how SME2 delivers significant performance gains when running AI workloads on Google’s Gemma 4 E2B model, including an average of 5.5x speedup in prefill (processing user input) and up to 1.6x faster decoding (generating responses).

summaryLinesEn: Work is moving faster, and enterprises now expect AI to take real tasks off their plates.

articles.title: Hugging Face cofounder: Open-weight AI models were ‘our savior’
articles.descEn: Hugging Face cofounder Thomas Wolf says open-weight models saved the company from the summer's OpenAI hack.
articles.titleEn: Hugging Face cofounder: Open-weight AI models were ‘our savior’
summaryLinesEn: HK Hugging Face co-founder says AI hacks show even the biggest labs haven't figured out AI alignment Yahoo Finance • 1d ago GOOGN META Why Hugging Face Is a $13 Billion Look Into AI’s Future Barrons.com • 2mo ago NVDA If open weight models are the future, U.S.
When OpenAI's models attacked Hugging Face, Wolf says the company couldn't use closed-weight models because their built-in guardrails wouldn't allow the firm to analyze the relevant hacking data.

When OpenAI's ( OPAI.PVT ) research models went rogue and hacked open-source AI site Hugging Face over the summer, cofounder and chief science officer Thomas Wolf says the company couldn't rely on closed models, such as those from OpenAI or Anthropic, to defend itself.

articles.title: Inside Dan Schulman’s war on the old Verizon | Fortune
articles.descEn: The former PayPal CEO left a Montana ranch to shake up one of America’s most profitable companies.
articles.titleEn: Inside Dan Schulman’s war on the old Verizon | Fortune
summaryLinesEn: In 2024, T-Mobile added a net 3.1 million postpaid phone lines and AT&T added 1.65 million; Verizon added less than 900,000.

Roxanne Austin, a Verizon director, recalls watching the company finish third among the major wireless carriers for 20 consecutive quarters, losing customers and market share while management kept prioritizing network infrastructure over customers’ changing needs.
Verizon is also looking to compete more aggressively for customers with deals like the new Simplicity offering, which lowers the starting monthly price for a single line from $65 to as low as $30.

articles.title: CoreWeave soars more than 24% for best day since April 2025 after strong Q3 report
articles.descEn: Neoclouds such as CoreWeave, Nebius and IREN have come under scrutiny this month as investors assessed the sustainability of the AI trade.
articles.titleEn: CoreWeave soars more than 24% for best day since April 2025 after strong Q3 report
summaryLinesEn: CoreWeave shares jumped 24.71% Wednesday for its best day since April 2025 after the neocloud posted quarterly earnings that beat estimates and raised its guidance for the year.
Intrator added that he expects it "will be underwritten in the market at 7% to 7.5% interest," which will bring down the average weighted cost of capital for the company.
Other neclouds also rose on CoreWeave's strong results, with Nebius rising 15.44%, Applied Digital 7.37% and Iren 5.63% Wednesday.

articles.title: United is restricting AI agents from booking flights - Engadget
articles.descEn: The airline believes AI poses security risks and may violate DOT and FAA rules.
articles.titleEn: United is restricting AI agents from booking flights - Engadget
summaryLinesEn: During its recent third-quarter earnings call, Uber shared that it handled 320 million trips and deliveries during the week of Halloween; of those, AI agents were responsible for 500 Uber Eats orders and only four rides.
Even if a large number of people are downloading apps like Muse , it seems like letting an agent shop for you isn't as frictionless or foolproof as it needs to be to catch on.
United Airlines has announced it will change ticking policies to restrict AI agents' from booking flights through its website, third-party travel agencies and flight aggregators.

articles.title: Google brings the Gemini app to Apple CarPlay - Engadget
articles.descEn: The chatbot was already available through the Google Maps app.
articles.titleEn: Google brings the Gemini app to Apple CarPlay - Engadget
summaryLinesEn: Google said you can pick up where you left off with Gemini in your car or start a new conversation with the chatbot.

Use Gemini in CarPlay to catch-up on what you have coming up in your schedule, talk through your inbox, or... pic.twitter.com/1s4luZ6q0v To use the assistant on CarPlay, you'll need to make sure you have the latest version of the Gemini app on your iPhone and the microphone permissions are on.

The company suggested drivers could use Gemini to prep for a meeting during their commute, catch up on emails, hear their Daily Brief or get recommendations for local places worth checking out in an area.

articles.title: With IPO looming, Anthropic launches AI models, workplace tools
articles.descEn: The generative vendor released new capabilities targeting enterprise work and significantly updated models as it prepares for the historic public offering.
articles.titleEn: With IPO looming, Anthropic launches AI models, workplace tools
summaryLinesEn: Anthropic said in an amended registration statement with the SEC filing on Tuesday that it would sell about 825 million shares for $70 to $78 per share.

Related: OpenAI’s Businesses in ChatGPT targets enterprise trust The releases and the vendor’s continued plans to pursue an IPO come after a week of upheaval in the financial markets, during which many investors responded to the shift in the political landscape and widespread dislike of AI data centers by selling their tech shares.
This new pricing is a noticeable reduction from version 5.1 of the two models, which cost $10 per million input tokens and $50 per million output tokens.

articles.title: Applied Materials (AMAT) Stock Gets Fair Value Trim As Margin Caution Offsets AI Demand
articles.descEn: The fair value estimate for Applied Materials has been revised slightly, easing from US$638.94 to US$620.78 as analysts refresh their models. This shift lines up with Street research that mixes caution on margins and discount rates with interest in AI driven wafer fab equipment and advanced packaging themes. As you read on, you will see how these moving targets shape the evolving Applied Materials narrative and what to watch next. Stay updated as the Fair Value for Applied Materials shifts by...
articles.titleEn: Applied Materials (AMAT) Stock Gets Fair Value Trim As Margin Caution Offsets AI Demand
summaryLinesEn: Several firms highlight Applied Materials as a key beneficiary of AI driven wafer fab equipment, memory, and advanced packaging demand.
The fair value estimate for Applied Materials has been revised slightly, easing from US$638.94 to US$620.78 as analysts refresh their models.
The net profit margin forecast has adjusted from 33.47% to 32.17%.

articles.title: Google’s Tabletop AI experiment lets you build custom collaboration apps
articles.descEn: Google has cooked up a new experimental AI tool called Tabletop that generates customized collaborative hubs to help you coordinate with family, and friends.
articles.titleEn: Google’s Tabletop AI experiment lets you build custom collaboration apps
summaryLinesEn: Google has cooked up a new experimental AI tool called Tabletop that generates customized collaborative hubs to help you coordinate with family, and friends.

“Just add in your links, files and ideas, then prompt @tabletop — or pick a starter template — to generate custom interactive trip itineraries, dinner polls, expense splitters and tournament brackets,” Google Labs design and engineering lead Roman Nurik said in the blog post.
Follow Follow See All Tech Tabletop provides customizable, collaborative spaces for all your personal planning needs.

Google Labs 디자인 및 엔지니어링 책임자인 Roman Nurik은 블로그 게시물에서 "링크, 파일 및 아이디어를 추가한 다음 @tabletop에 메시지를 표시하거나 시작 템플릿을 선택하여 맞춤형 대화형 여행 일정, 저녁 투표, 비용 분할 및 토너먼트 브래킷을 생성하기만 하면 됨" · 라고 말함
팔로우 팔로우 모두 보기 Tech Tabletop은 모든 개인 계획 요구 사항에 맞는 맞춤형 협업 공간을 제공함

articles.title: A 13-Year-Old Asked AI About Suicide on Her School Laptop. It Didn’t Get Flagged for Weeks
articles.descEn: The young girl’s parents allege that she used Gemini via her school Chromebook to plan her suicide, but the school’s monitoring systems didn’t know until it was almost too late.
articles.titleEn: A 13-Year-Old Asked AI About Suicide on Her School Laptop. It Didn’t Get Flagged for Weeks
summaryLinesEn: A 2022 white paper from the EdWeek Research Center found that in a survey of 1,000 American K-12 educators, 96 percent of Gaggle users believed that it helped to “keep students safe from suicide and/or self-harm.”
As classrooms continue to rely on Google’s low-cost offerings, including Gemini, their ability to keep up with the potential risks is front and center.

A 13-year-old girl spent three months using her school-issued laptop to discuss depression, research suicide, and plan her funeral before self-harm-monitoring software finally prompted school officials to alert her parents, who intervened and stopped her, according to a lawsuit filed this month by her parents.

summaryLines: EdWeek Research Center의 2022년 백서에 따르면 미국 K-12 교육자 1,000명을 대상으로 한 설문조사에서 Gaggle 사용자의 96%가 Gaggle이 '학생들을 자살 및/또는 자해로부터 안전하게 보호'하는 데 도움이 된다고 믿었음
교실에서는 Gemini를 포함한 Google의 저렴한 제품에 계속 의존하고 있기 때문에 잠재적인 위험에 대처하는 능력이 가장 중요함
이번 달 부모가 제기한 소송에 따르면, 13세 소녀가 학교에서 지급한 노트북을 사용하여 우울증에 대해 논의하고, 자살에 대해 연구하고, 장례식을 계획하는 데 3개월을 보냈지만, 자해 모니터링 소프트웨어가 마침내 학교 관계자에게 부모에게 알리도록 했고, 그녀는 개입하여 그녀를 막았음

articles.title: US corporate AI spending hits a new high in October, but growth slows to 1.65 percent
articles.descEn: According to the Ramp AI Index, US corporate AI spending rose just 1.65 percent in October 2026. One percent of companies still drive 80 percent of revenue for OpenAI and Anthropic. Customer support is emerging as a new growth driver, but it may bring lower margins than the coding business that has fueled spending so far.
articles.titleEn: US corporate AI spending hits a new high in October, but growth slows to 1.65 percent
summaryLinesEn: US corporate AI spending rose just 1.65 percent month over month in October 2026 to a new high, according to the Ramp AI Index, with the top one percent of companies paying a median of $10,200 per employee per month while the typical company spent $16.32.
Usage volume is growing faster than spending, so AI keeps getting cheaper, driven by competitive pressure between OpenAI and Anthropic along with open-weight models from China.
US corporate AI spending hit a new high in October 2026, but growth was modest.

articles.title: Databricks' new AI agent tells CEO Ali Ghodsi the unvarnished truth
articles.descEn: At 12,000 employees, AI Ghodsi is the first to admit that he can't know everyone and that they are unlikely to confess the things that go wrong to him. But he doesn't need them to. He uses Databricks' newly revised Genie agent for that.
articles.titleEn: Databricks' new AI agent tells CEO Ali Ghodsi the unvarnished truth
summaryLinesEn: Instead of a product demo, he fired up his actual agent and walked me through his most recent chats and charts.
He showed me how it summarized a big sales pitch to a prospect that went poorly — including the features the prospect said it needed before buying.
As for the risk that agents will ratchet up corporate AI costs, Ghodsi has an answer for that, too.

articles.title: Plurai wants to help AI agents work better using the same approach that helped get self-driving cars to roads
articles.descEn: Like the end-to-end models trained to drive cars, AI agents are probabilistic systems operating in unpredictable environments.
articles.titleEn: Plurai wants to help AI agents work better using the same approach that helped get self-driving cars to roads
summaryLinesEn: On Wednesday, the startup said it had raised $13 million in seed funding to make that happen.

As businesses try to optimize their AI expense, Plurai’s approach could prove a real advantage, since IT leaders are seeing that “frontier-capable models are out of distribution with my specific data, and the cost of these things isn’t sustainable in the long term,” Miyara said.

LiveBench 2.0 shows Claude Fable 5.2 and ChatGPT-6 Astra succeeding on 82.9 and 75.6 out of 100 tasks, respectively, and an effort by the AI infrastructure company EON to test agents in a simulated corporate environment found the most successful model tested, Claude Opus 4.8, performed tasks at 76.8% accuracy.

articles.title: Adobe’s AI experiments let you walk around in photos and interview your characters
articles.descEn: Adobe’s sneaks can transform images into explorable 3D scenes, design AI characters by talking to them, and turn photo editing into a copy/paste process.
articles.titleEn: Adobe’s AI experiments let you walk around in photos and interview your characters
summaryLinesEn: Almost all of these projects are built around Adobe’s generative AI developments, however, and given AI tools now play a central role in the company’s growth strategy, it’s likely that at least some of the experiments will see an official launch.
While the visuals in the 3D environment are pixelated and ill–defined, the resolution quality is restored when you select your chosen angle.
In some cases the features almost seem like toys, but with the benefit of allowing you to make practical changes to creative projects.

summaryLines: 이러한 프로젝트의 대부분은 Adobe의 생성적 AI 개발을 기반으로 구축되었지만 이제 AI 도구가 회사의 성장 전략에서 중심 역할을 한다는 점을 감안할 때 적어도 일부 실험은 공식적으로 출시될 가능성이 높음
3D 환경의 시각적 요소는 픽셀화되어 있고 정의가 불분명하지만 선택한 각도를 선택하면 해상도 품질이 복원됨
어떤 경우에는 기능이 거의 장난감처럼 보이지만 창의적인 프로젝트에 실질적인 변화를 줄 수 있다는 이점이 있음
